items.title: Student Tech Support Specialist
items.description: Provided technical support for university customers, including hardware, software, and account troubleshooting; installation and configuration; and technical documentation.

items.title: Drafting Technician Intern
items.description: Supported engineering and manufacturing through CAD drawings and models, technical documentation, engineering changes, and configuration-related work.

items.title: Adjunct Faculty
items.description: Taught engineering technology coursework and laboratories as adjunct faculty.

items.title: Instructor
items.description: Served as a full-time engineering technology instructor, teaching technical coursework and laboratories and supporting student development.

items.title: Assistant Professor / Program Director
items.description: Led engineering technology program activities including curriculum development, laboratory operations, budgeting, continuous improvement, teaching, industry collaboration, student mentoring, accreditation support, and program assessment.

items.title: Systems Engineer
items.description: Supports modernization of mission-critical electrical test equipment used to verify guidance and control systems, with work spanning requirements, electrical design, reverse engineering, systems integration, verification and validation, model-based systems engineering, and multidisciplinary coordination.
